verdicts.decision_note: The client accepts fabric-specific colour calibration and identifies voile fabrication and Pantone references for preparing the print files.
The client confirms visual colour approximation followed by Pantone refinement and supplier ICC-profile use when available.
The client accepts using the revised final shades with exact CMYK values and nearest Pantone equivalents; the removals correctly retire the superseded provisional matching plans.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports delivering CMYK and Pantone references corresponding to the final revised shades.
